name: Magpie 8B
blurb: A small model on shared hardware. Reads every file on a server for you and notes what matters, and picks out the log lines that point at you.

name: Kestrel 7B
blurb: A small model that only watches. It follows your traces and cuts the line just before one reaches you.

name: Heron 120B
blurb: A large model on its own hardware. Everything Magpie does. It also reads a message over before you send it and says what is wrong with it, and it watches your traces and cuts the line just before one reaches you.
